title: Monorepo scaffold
acceptance: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo with apps/web, apps/api, apps/gateway, apps/mobile (placeholder), packages/contracts, packages/ui, packages/config. TypeScript strict, ESLint, Prettier. `pnpm build` and `pnpm test` pass from the root and each app boots locally.

title: Local dev stack
acceptance: Docker Compose for Postgres 16, Redis 7, MinIO, Mailpit and a LiveKit dev server. `pnpm dev` starts everything; README steps work on a fresh machine.

title: CI pipeline
acceptance: GitHub Actions: lint, typecheck, unit tests, build, Playwright smoke, dependency cache. Required check on main.

title: Staging and PR previews in Singapore
acceptance: Cloud account in the Singapore region, Kubernetes staging namespace, managed Postgres, Redis and S3, secrets manager. Every PR gets a preview URL for the web app.

title: Migrations and seed data
acceptance: Drizzle migrations run in CI and on deploy. Seed matches the prototype: Acme workspace; Alice, Bob, Chi, Dũng, Hà and the guest Khách Mời; #general, #design, #du-an-alpha (private), #releases.

title: Observability baseline
acceptance: Structured JSON logs, OpenTelemetry traces across api and gateway, Sentry for web and api, /healthz and /readyz endpoints, a staging dashboard.

title: Apple and Google developer accounts
acceptance: Apple Developer (organisation) and Google Play accounts, bundle IDs, APNs key, Firebase project for FCM. Started in week 1 because approval can take two weeks.

title: Expo app skeleton and build lanes
acceptance: Expo app in apps/mobile importing packages/contracts and the API client; EAS internal builds for iOS and Android from CI. Placeholder sign-in screen. Prepared before the mobile hire joins.

title: Identity schema with tenant isolation
acceptance: Tables workspace, user, membership (owner/admin/member/guest), session, device. Postgres row-level security on workspace_id; a test proves one workspace cannot read another's rows.

title: Company sign-in (OIDC, then SAML)
acceptance: OIDC for Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra, SAML via a maintained library. Users from verified company domains are provisioned on first sign-in. Audit event on every sign-in.

title: Email sign-in
acceptance: Magic link valid 15 minutes, single use; display name asked on first sign-in. Emails go to Mailpit locally.

title: Test personas (dev only)
acceptance: “Sign in as a test person” for Owner, Member and Admin seeds behind DEV_PERSONAS. A test fails the build if the route exists in a production bundle.

title: Sessions and revocation
acceptance: httpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie sessions with rotation; device record; API to list and revoke all sessions (used later by “Sign out everywhere”). Revocation closes open WebSockets within 5 s.

title: Sign-in screen
acceptance: Built to the SignIn board: company account, test personas, email + display name, language picker. Error states for expired link and unknown domain.

title: Hash-chained audit writer
acceptance: Append-only audit_event with prev_hash and SHA-256 hash, written in the same transaction as the change. Covers sign-in, session revoke, role change. Verifier ships later; the chain starts now.

title: Design tokens and themes
acceptance: Port the prototype's dark and light tokens, Inter and JetBrains Mono, comfortable and compact density. Theme setting: match system, light, dark; toggle in the rail.

title: Core components
acceptance: Button, IconButton, Avatar (hue initials + presence dot), Badge, Tabs, Menu, Dialog, Toggle, Select, Input, Tooltip in packages/ui with Storybook. axe accessibility checks in CI.

title: App shell
acceptance: Icon rail + side panel + main pane, collapsible side panel, routes for Home, DMs, Activity, Files, Later; active view styling and badges slots.

title: Visual regression harness
acceptance: Playwright screenshots of the shell and components in both themes, compared on every PR.

title: i18n framework
acceptance: ICU message catalogs, English strings extracted from the boards, Vietnamese catalog scaffolded. Locale-aware dates with 24-hour default and per-user time zone.

title: Vietnamese text utilities
acceptance: NFC normalisation on write; accent folding for search and autocomplete (“phat hanh” matches “phát hành”, đ → d). Shared in packages/contracts with unit tests.

title: WebSocket gateway
acceptance: Session-authenticated WebSocket, heartbeat, client reconnect with backoff, Redis pub/sub fan-out to user and conversation channels. Horizontal scale proven with two gateway pods.

title: Event envelope and sequence numbers
acceptance: Typed event contracts; per-conversation seq; client resumes from last seq and fetches gaps over REST, so no message is lost across reconnects.

title: Connection indicator
acceptance: “Connected” state in the side panel; offline banner and reconnecting state.

title: Conversation and membership API
acceptance: Kinds public, private, dm, group_dm; create, update, join, leave; member role manager. Permission checks for private channels.

title: Create a channel
acceptance: Dialog with name (lowercase, hyphens, Vietnamese folded to a slug), private toggle, description. Audit event channel.create.

title: Channel directory
acceptance: Search by name or description, Any/Only joined, A to Z, member counts, Joined/Private/Archived badges, Join, Leave, Open.

title: DMs and group DMs
acceptance: Open-or-create 1:1 DM; group DMs up to 8 people; New message picker; DM inbox with previews and unread counts; intro block with View profile.

title: Make private and archive
acceptance: One-way private conversion with in-page confirmation; archive makes a channel read-only and hides it from the sidebar. Both audited.

title: Message model and send API
acceptance: Rich-text JSON (ProseMirror schema shared in contracts), idempotency key, seq assignment, per-user rate limit, message.created event.

title: Message list
acceptance: Virtualised list, day dividers, grouping of consecutive messages, load older, jump to latest. 50-message channel opens under 500 ms.

title: Optimistic send and failures
acceptance: Pending and failed states, retry and discard, ordering preserved when sends resolve out of order.

title: Edit and delete
acceptance: Edit window from workspace setting (default no limit), “edited” label, delete leaves a tombstone when the message has replies.

title: Reactions
acceptance: Add and remove, counts, who-reacted tooltip, quick reactions; reaction events.

title: Pins
acceptance: Pin and unpin, Pinned label on the message, Pins tab with count.

title: Mentions and channel links
acceptance: @person, @channel, @here, @everyone (permission hook), #channel links; own mentions highlighted.

title: Code formatting
acceptance: Inline code and code blocks in the monospace face with a copy button.

title: Link unfurls
acceptance: Worker fetches Open Graph data with SSRF protection and a 3 s timeout, caches results, skips blocked domains; preview card with title, description and domain.

title: Typing indicator
acceptance: Throttled typing events through Redis, 6 s expiry, “X is typing…” line; respects the “Show when people are typing” preference.

title: Presence
acceptance: Online and away from gateway heartbeats and idle detection; presence dots everywhere avatars appear; online-first DM ordering.

title: Composer editor
acceptance: Tiptap editor on the shared schema: bold, italic, strikethrough, link, bulleted and numbered lists, quote, code, code block, with keyboard shortcuts; Aa toggle hides the toolbar.

title: Mention and channel autocomplete
acceptance: @ and # pickers, accent-insensitive, members ranked first, keyboard navigation.

title: Emoji picker
acceptance: Search, recently used, skin tone; shared by composer and reactions.

title: Send key setting
acceptance: Enter sends by default; “Ctrl+Enter sends; Enter starts a new line” option.

title: Drafts
acceptance: Unsent text saved per conversation on the server, restored on any device, listed under Drafts.

title: Upload pipeline
acceptance: Presigned S3 uploads with progress, size limit, MIME sniffing, ClamAV scan job, image thumbnails and video posters.

title: Attachments in messages
acceptance: Inline images and video per preference, file cards with size and type, Files & links tab per conversation.

title: Thread model and summary
acceptance: thread_root_id, reply count, last reply time and participant avatars on the root; thread.replied event.

title: Thread pane
acceptance: Built to the Thread board: root and replies, reply composer, “Also send to channel”.

title: Follow and unfollow
acceptance: Auto-follow when you post or are mentioned; manual Follow/Unfollow in the pane.

title: Read state and unread counts
acceptance: last_read_seq per member, unread and mention counts, mark read on view, “New messages” divider, counts synced across devices.

title: Side panel
acceptance: Starred, Channels and Direct messages sections; unread bold + badge; star and unstar; Find a conversation; filter and sort menu.

title: Side panel shortcuts
acceptance: All unreads, Threads (followed threads list), Drafts and Directories entries.

title: Jump to (Ctrl K)
acceptance: Quick switcher over channels and people, fuzzy and accent-insensitive, recent first, full keyboard support.

title: Channel header
acceptance: Name, topic, member stack and count, star, notification-setting stub, Messages / Files & links / Pins tabs, Meet button placeholder.

title: Profile fields
acceptance: Display name, full name, title, pronouns, phone, time zone, photo upload with crop.

title: Profile card
acceptance: Popover from any avatar: names, title, local time, email, phone, Message action.

title: Avatar and workspace menu
acceptance: Workspace info, Jump to, Browse channels, Preferences, Sign out wired; Admin console item for admins only.

title: People directory
acceptance: Search by name, title or email; Title and Location filters; presence; Most relevant sort.

title: Channel details
acceptance: About (name, topic, description), member list, Make manager, Remove, Add people, “Only channel managers can post” enforced by the API, Leave.

title: Preferences store and Settings dialog
acceptance: Typed preference schema in contracts, one row per user, synced live. Settings dialog with all 12 tabs; Profile & status and Messages & media wired, the rest labelled as coming later.

title: LiveKit on staging
acceptance: LiveKit with TURN on staging, token endpoint, one room per conversation, two-person call on a test page from two networks.

title: End-to-end flows
acceptance: Playwright: sign in, create channel, post, react, reply in thread, DM, upload a file. Runs on every PR in under 8 minutes.

title: Load smoke test
acceptance: 200 simulated clients across 10 channels; send-to-render p95 under 300 ms on staging; report filed.

title: Week 8 pilot in #du-an-alpha
acceptance: Move one project channel onto Toki for real work; collect issues in a feedback log; triage into P2/P3.
